It's the game you have been waiting for, tomorrow we face @StockportCounty for the first time in the @Cheshire_FA senior cup and club history. Lets make it a game to remember as we welcome the EFL league one side to Hind Heath Road. 
Please arrive early to avoid queing. https://t.co/jU4UUxCnYP

Dec and JKD reflect on The Bach securing an important win and another 3 points, as we extend our unbeaten run and keep up the pressure on the teams below them who have a couple of games in hand. https://t.co/i8LELDZOpP

🔵⚪️ v🟣🟣

Sandbach United v Cheadle Heath Nomads

Finishes here 3 1 to The Bach with first half goals from Fowles, Birchall and Hatton and an important 3 points as we maintain our place at the top of the League. 2nd half saw us generally dominate but few chances for either side
